plugin.name: Bot Plugin Bridge
plugin.description: Loads bot plugins (MaiBot / NoneBot2 / AstrBot / Koishi etc.) inside N.E.K.O: their commands, tools and event handlers become NEKO entries and chat-time tools; send / LLM / storage calls fall back to NEKO capabilities.
entry.bridge_status.name: Bridge status
entry.bridge_status.description: Loaded bot plugins, per-framework status and the last error.
entry.bridge_list_plugins.name: List bot plugins
entry.bridge_list_plugins.description: List every loaded bot plugin (MaiBot / NoneBot2 / AstrBot / Koishi etc.) with its commands, tools and events.
entry.bridge_run_command.name: Run bot plugin command
entry.bridge_run_command.description: Hand a user message to foreign bot plugins for command / event handling.
entry.bridge_call_api.name: Call bot plugin API
entry.bridge_call_api.description: Invoke an API / tool exposed by a foreign bot plugin.
entry.bridge_reload.name: Reload bot plugins
entry.bridge_reload.description: Rescan and reload the bot plugin directory.
tool.bridge_run_command.description: Let bot plugins (MaiBot / NoneBot2 / AstrBot / Koishi etc.) handle a message (e.g. trigger their commands).
tool.bridge_call_plugin_tool.description: Call a tool / command registered by a bot plugin.
tool.bridge_list_plugins.description: List available bot plugins, commands and tools.
entry.bridge_market_sources.name: Bot plugin market sources
entry.bridge_market_sources.description: List the available bot plugin market sources and their status.
entry.bridge_market_search.name: Search bot plugins
entry.bridge_market_search.description: Search the official bot plugin indexes (MaiBot / NoneBot2 / AstrBot / Koishi, read-only).
entry.bridge_market_install.name: Install bot plugin
entry.bridge_market_install.description: Install a plugin from a market source into the isolated plugin directory and hot-reload.
tool.bridge_market_search.description: Search the bot plugin markets (MaiBot / NoneBot2 / AstrBot / Koishi, read-only).
